phases.title: QuranProgressChart — beautiful client-side weekly progress chart (UI-only, Opus craft)
preconditions: VERIFY FIRST: QuranPage already fetches and holds the full session list client-side (it renders a session list, fetched in the existing useEffect ~QuranPage.tsx:107-110). If the page only holds a summary (not the per-session rows), STOP and surface that server-side aggregation is needed instead — do not silently add a backend aggregation path.

Resolve the chart-primitive cross-feature ownership question: duplicate the ~12-line ChartContainer wrapper into features/quran/front/components/shared/, OR promote nivoTheme/palette/childColors to features/lib as shared design tokens — do not silently cross-import from features/dashboard/front (architecture-rules).

BEAUTY BAR (ui-style-guide): this page must meet the same polish level as the messaging surface — reuse the forest/slate palette and childColors tokens, the icon-in-circle empty state, and animate-pulse skeletons. Do NOT reuse the chat-bubble metaphor; match the polish, not the conversation pattern.
testsFirst: NEW TEST: pure bucketing helper unit test — given session rows spanning several weeks, returns correct week-start buckets and counts, with an empty-input case returning [] (no DB, no mocks)

NEW TEST: features/quran/__tests__/integration/ — QuranProgressChart renders the populated chart container, a polished empty state (icon-in-circle + headline 'No Quran sessions logged yet' + hint), and an animate-pulse loading skeleton; Nivo is mocked per Jest config so assertions target the container/empty/loading affordances, not SVG output
implementationSteps: Implement a pure bucketByWeek(sessions) helper (colocated with the component) grouping the already-fetched session rows into weekly session-count buckets via useMemo — no API/route/service/schema change
Resolve the chart-primitive gate (duplicate ChartContainer into features/quran/front/components/shared/, or promote nivoTheme/palette/childColors to features/lib) and record the choice

Build QuranProgressChart ('use client', ResponsiveLine or ResponsiveBar following WeeklyActivity conventions): useMemo { data, isEmpty }, explicit array/object props (data, theme={nivoTheme}, margin, axisBottom/axisLeft with explicit format fns, legends as an explicit array or custom HTML legend, tooltip render fn, and layers/markers/defs/fill as explicit [] if ResponsiveLine)

BEAUTY: color the series from the shared forest/childColors palette (per-learner color where relevant); add a soft area gradient fill under the line via defs+fill, a smooth curve, light/no heavy gridlines, and a styled accessible tooltip — visually consistent with the dashboard charts and the messaging polish bar

BEAUTY: frame the chart in the app card surface (card / add-form-card with a 'form-section-heading' title e.g. 'Memorization progress'), responsive height ~220-260, consistent spacing; the empty state is a centered icon-in-circle (h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-forest-50 text-forest-700 + a lucide-react glyph) over a headline + hint (mirroring ui-style-guide empty-state quality), and loading is an animate-pulse skeleton mirroring the chart footprint — never a spinner
Render the chart in QuranPage between the page intro and the session list, fed by the sessions array the page already holds (no new fetch)

Manual browser smoke after landing: npm run dev, /quran with seeded demo data (npm run db:reset:demo), confirm no undefined.map/.length crash, axes/legend/tooltip render, the gradient/curve look polished, and the empty state shows for a zero-session learner — document in PR
doneWhen: MANUAL: npm run dev, open /quran with seeded demo household, verify the chart renders without undefined.map/.length crashes, looks polished (palette, gradient, tooltip), and the empty state appears for a zero-session learner (Jest's Nivo mock cannot catch this)
phases.writeBack: QuranProgressChart added (ResponsiveLine/Bar per WeeklyActivity conventions) and rendered in QuranPage between intro and session list; buckets the already-fetched sessions client-side via a pure weekly helper in a useMemo — NO backend/route/service/schema change. Built to the beauty bar: shared forest/childColors palette, area-gradient fill, smooth curve, styled tooltip, card framing, icon-in-circle empty state, animate-pulse loading skeleton. Chart-primitive decision recorded as duplicated-into-quran OR promoted-to-lib (state which + the import path). The dead chartData:[] stub in sessions.ts was left untouched (no longer needed). Manual browser smoke documented. Closes c9f5e6c9.
